searchText: Tell them to join discord and vote if they are an ecosystem developer. 😄 But only do that for people who will vote my way. 😉 He’s already in here haha Since 1559 will raise mainnet gas limit to 30M and the base fee starts at 1e9, we can be rather sure that the first X blocks on mainnet are going to be ~100% full. Are we sure we can handle this sudden 2x gas limit bump? Does 1559 override the min gas limit check of 5k? We have this at JS currently ```typescript validateGasLimit(parentBlockHeader: BlockHeader): boolean { // Pre EIP-1559 gaslimit check if (!this._common.isActivatedEIP(1559)) { const parentGasLimit = parentBlockHeader.gasLimit const gasLimit = this.gasLimit const hardfork = this._getHardfork() const a = parentGasLimit.div( new BN(this._common.paramByHardfork('gasConfig', 'gasLimitBoundDivisor', hardfork)) ) const maxGasLimit = parentGasLimit.add(a) const minGasLimit = parentGasLimit.sub(a) return ( gasLimit.lt(maxGasLimit) && gasLimit.gt(minGasLimit) && gasLimit.gte(this._common.paramByHardfork('gasConfig', 'minGasLimit', hardfork)) ) // EIP-1559 gasTarget check } else { const parentGasTarget = parentBlockHeader.gasLimit // check if the block changed the gas target too much return ( this.gasLimit.lte(parentGasTarget.add(parentGasTarget.divn(1024))) && this.gasLimit.gte(parentGasTarget.sub(parentGasTarget.divn(1024))) ) } } ``` This seems to match the spec but I'm rather sure that the spec does not intend to override the min gas limit. Yes. All testing of 1559 with super duper big blocks went well. What gas limit check are you referring to? The 5k min gas limit from the yellow paper I'll find where it's in the YP Page 7 def (47) If we would let gas limit go below 1024 (which is practically not possible of course) then the gas limit would be stuck. According to current rules No it doesn’t AFAIK Not sure what you mean here. Do we delete the min 5k gas limit rule or do we keep it? It should be kept aleut down? no new blocks in 15h Ah, I didn't even know about that lower limit. Yeah, removing it wasn't intentional. A PR to update the spec to be more clear would probably be valuable. And another example of why core EIPs should be PRs against an actual spec document. 😄 I'll open a PR https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/3560 cc <@574864862338088960> I didnt say this, but BSC showed that 30m blocks is not a problem for our Ethereum clients 🙃 cc: <@&836981603216654336> Where is our scaling problem amirite? looking at aleut now my bad, I only updated one of the two besu aleut nodes. We are moving again (and processing 2930 transactions <@!508125616940515329> ) Ah great 🙂
